name: featurelab
description: Live preview for Bedrock worldgen feature/rule JSON, driven by the featurelab engine.

featurelab.binaryPath.description: Path to the featurelab engine executable. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with this extension. Set this during development to point at a locally built cmd/featurelab binary.

featurelab.env.description: Environment preset id passed to `generate` (see featurelab/env for the available presets).

featurelab.blockTextures.description: Draw blocks with real Minecraft textures instead of flat per-block colours. The first preview offers, once, to fetch Mojang's sample resource pack (bedrock-samples, about 150 MB transferred) into your user cache directory; nothing is downloaded without that. Declining, being offline, or turning this off all leave the preview drawing flat block colours, which is what it has always drawn -- textures are an enhancement and nothing here can stop the preview working.

featurelab.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the engine to respond to a request (loadPack/generate) before treating it as stale. For generate requests this is a floor, not a ceiling: the extension automatically waits longer when the panel's Budget section raises the placement time limit above this value, and shows the raised wait there when it does.

scripts.package: npm run build:binary && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o featurelab.vsix
